recipe.visualDefinition: A medium portrait of a male figure set against a stylized urban backdrop featuring high-contrast city buildings, a blue radial sunburst sky, and bold, textured display typography in the upper left corner.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject positioned in the right foreground against a receding city silhouette
Radial sunburst lines originating from behind the subject's head
Typography integrated with background textures through diagonal hatching
Cool blue sky contrasting with warm skin tones and dark building silhouettes
coreInvariants: Diagonal hatching texture within the letterforms
Asymmetrical composition with heavy weight on the right

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium shot, subject occupies the right two-thirds of the frame, angled slightly toward the viewer.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the large-scale typography in the top-left quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the bold text in the top left, down the diagonal lines of the sunburst to the subject's face, then down to the crossed arms.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The central sky area provides a bright focal point between the dark building silhouettes and the subject.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Sky blue and cerulean blue in the background and subject's clothing.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black and charcoal for the building silhouettes and shadows.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm tan and brown skin tones for the subject.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the bright sky and dark buildings; medium saturation in the blues.

letterConstructionRules: Internal fill consists of 45-degree diagonal hatching lines
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'A' has a low horizontal bar
The 'Q' features a short, straight diagonal tail
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used for all display elements to maintain graphic impact.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary verticality and weight for the hatching effect.
Geometric structure matches the modern urban feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a medium portrait of a man in a blue t-shirt standing in front of a New York style cityscape with water towers. The background should feature a light blue radial sunburst pattern. The buildings should be high-contrast, dark silhouettes with visible window details.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply two lines of large, extra-bold geometric sans-serif text in the top left. Fill the text with a 45-degree diagonal black hatching pattern. Ensure the text is tightly tracked and stacked.

verificationChecks: Is the text filled with diagonal lines?
Is there a radial sunburst in the sky?
Are the buildings dark and high-contrast?
Is the subject positioned on the right side?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original person
Any specific brand logos on clothing

mustAchieve: Clear separation between foreground subject and background city

postGenerationChecks: Text is uppercase and stacked in the top left
Diagonal hatching is consistent across all letters
Sunburst originates from a central point behind the subject
Color palette is strictly blue, black, and skin tones
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Portrait + Radial Sunburst Background + Diagonal Hatched Display Type
